    Super Bowl LXI is scheduled for
    February 14, 2027, at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California, marking the second time the venue has hosted the championship. The game will be televised by ABC and simulcast on ESPN. It is the first Super Bowl to fall on Valentine's Day and a President's Day weekend. 
    • Date: February 14, 2027
    • Location: SoFi Stadium, Inglewood, California (Greater Los Angeles Area)
    • Network: ABC and ESPN (simulcast)
    • Teams: TBD. As of early 2026, early betting speculation and analyst reports mention potential contenders like the Bengals and Cowboys or a repeat of the 2026 Seahawks-Patriots matchup.
    • Halftime Performer: To be announced. Potential artists discussed include Post Malone, Morgan Wallen, or artists under Roc Nation, such as Lil Wayne or Drake.
    • Ticket Prices: Official tickets are not yet on sale, but fans can place a $2,500 priority access deposit for guaranteed seats, with priority given to Rams season ticket members. 
    This event will mark the ninth time the Super Bowl has been held in the Los Angeles area.
